fields.summary_ko.0: American Express (AXP) reported Q3 adjusted EPS of $4.68, exceeding consensus estimate by 5%, raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $17.60–$17.90, and recorded quarterly revenue of $20.06B (+9% YoY).
fields.summary_ko.1: Cardmember spending increased to $454B (+8%), net interest income and card fee growth remain strong, and Visa and Mastercard are scheduled to report Q3 results this week.
